妈妈.pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ de mā ma
Wǒ mèi mei hěn xiàng wǒ mā ma
妈妈.en: My little sister looks like my mum.
妈妈.es: Mi hermana pequeña se parece a mi madre.

妈妈.pinyin: Nǐ de mā ma huì kāi chē ma
妈妈.en: Can your mother drive a car?

妈妈.pinyin: Wǒ bù jué de tā xiàng tā mā ma
妈妈.en: I don't think she takes after her mother.
妈妈.es: No creo que se parezca a su madre.

同学.zh: 一些同学看到我给他巧克力了。
同学.pinyin: Yī xiē tóng xué kàn dào wǒ gěi tā qiǎo kè lì le
同学.en: Some classmates saw me give him chocolate.
同学.es: Algunos compañeros de clase me vieron dándole chocolate.

同学.zh: 我没有一个同学住在这儿附近。
同学.pinyin: Wǒ méi yǒu yī ge tóng xué zhù zài zhèr fù jìn
同学.en: None of my classmates live near here.
同学.es: Ninguno de mis compañeros de clase vive cerca de aquí.

同学.zh: 一些同学看见我给了他巧克力。
同学.pinyin: Yī xiē tóng xué kàn jiàn wǒ gěi le tā qiǎo kè lì
同学.en: Some classmates saw me give him chocolate.
同学.es: Algunos compañeros de clase me vieron dándole chocolate.

还.zh: 我还了从图书馆借的书，又借了些新的。
还.pinyin: Wǒ hái le cóng tú shū guǎn jiè de shū yòu jiè le xiē xīn de
还.en: I returned the books I borrowed from the library, and I borrowed some new ones.
还.es: Devolví los libros que había sacado de la biblioteca y me llevé prestados otros nuevos.

还.pinyin: Wǒ fù mǔ hái bù lǎo
还.es: Mis padres todavía no son viejos.

还.zh: 他还没有去过法国，他很想明年去。
还.pinyin: Tā hái méi yǒu qù guo fǎ guó tā hěn xiǎng míng nián qù
还.en: He still hasn't been to France; he really wants to go next year.
还.es: Todavía no ha ido a Francia pero tiene muchas ganas de ir el año que viene.

还.pinyin: Nǐ hái xū yào chá ma

高.zh: 是的，他几乎和我一样高。
高.pinyin: Shì de tā jī hū hé wǒ yī yàng gāo
高.en: Yes, he's almost as tall as I am.
高.es: Sí, él y yo somos casi igual de altos.

高.pinyin: Tā hé wǒ yī yàng gāo
高.en: He is as tall as I.
高.es: Es igual de alto que yo.

高.pinyin: Wǒ dì di méi wǒ liǎng nián qián gāo
高.en: My brother is not as tall as I was two years ago.
高.es: Mi hermano no es tan alto como lo era yo hace dos años.

高.pinyin: Tā hé tā yī yàng gāo
高.en: He is as tall as her.
高.es: Él es igual de alto que ella.

咖啡.zh: 我要的是茶，而他却给了我一杯咖啡。
咖啡.pinyin: Wǒ yào de shì chá ér tā què gěi le wǒ yī bēi kā fēi
咖啡.en: He brought me coffee, when I had asked for tea.
咖啡.es: Me trajo un café, aunque había pedido un té.

咖啡.zh: “你想再来点咖啡吗？”“不，谢谢。我够了。”
咖啡.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng zài lái diǎn kā fēi ma bù xiè xie wǒ gòu le
咖啡.en: "Will you have some more coffee?" "No, thanks. I've had enough."
咖啡.es: "¿Se va a servir un poco más de café?" "No gracias. Ya he bebido suficiente."

咖啡.pinyin: Nǐ kā fēi hē de tài duō le

咖啡.zh: 你一把它放进去，就不能把牛奶和咖啡分开了。
咖啡.pinyin: Nǐ yī bǎ tā fàng jìn qù jiù bù néng bǎ niú nǎi hé kā fēi fēn kāi le
咖啡.en: You cannot separate the milk from the coffee once you put it in.
咖啡.es: No se puede separar la leche del café una vez que la hayas metido.

题.zh: 我们谈论了各种各样的话题。
题.pinyin: Wǒ men tán lùn le gè zhǒng gè yàng de huà tí
题.en: We discussed a wide range of topics.
题.es: Discutimos una amplia gama de temas.

题.zh: 这是一道深奥的数学题。
题.pinyin: Zhè shì yī dào shēn ào de shù xué tí
题.en: This is a difficult math problem.
题.es: Este es un problema de matemáticas difícil.

题.zh: 我用五分钟就算好了那道题。
题.pinyin: Wǒ yòng wǔ fēn zhōng jiù suàn hǎo le nà dào tí
题.en: It took me five minutes to solve the problem.
题.es: Me llevó cinco minutos resolver el problema.

题.zh: 你真的需要提问题来知道答案吗？
题.pinyin: Nǐ zhēn de xū yào tí wèn tí lái zhī dào dá àn ma
题.en: Do you really need to ask the question to know the answer?
题.es: ¿Realmente necesitas preguntar para saber la respuesta?

左边.zh: 我的房间在楼上的左边。
左边.pinyin: Wǒ de fáng jiān zài lóu shàng de zuǒ bian
左边.en: My room is upstairs on the left.
左边.es: Mi cuarto está subiendo las escaleras a la izquierda.

左边.zh: 他的母亲坐在他的左边。
左边.pinyin: Tā de mǔ qīn zuò zài tā de zuǒ bian
左边.en: On his left sat his mother.
左边.es: Su madre se sentó a su izquierda.

左边.zh: 电脑放在女士们的左边。
左边.pinyin: Diàn nǎo fàng zài nǚ shì men de zuǒ bian
左边.en: The computer is placed to the left of the women.
左边.es: El ordenador está a la izquierda de ella.

左边.zh: 打开左边的橱，瓶子在那儿。
左边.pinyin: Dǎ kāi zuǒ bian de chú píng zi zài nàr
左边.en: Open the cupboard to the left, the bottles are in there.
左边.es: Abre el armario de la izquierda, allí están las botellas.

认为.zh: 根据你所说的话，我认为我们应该重新审视我们的计划。
认为.pinyin: Gēn jù nǐ suǒ shuō de huà wǒ rèn wéi wǒ men yīng gāi chóng xīn shěn shì wǒ men de jì huà
认为.en: In the light of what you told us, I think we should revise our plan.
认为.es: A la luz de lo que nos dijo, creo que deberíamos revisar nuestro plan.

认为.pinyin: Nǐ bù zhè me rèn wéi ma
Wǒ bù rèn wéi míng tiān huì xià yǔ
认为.en: I don't think that it will rain tomorrow.

认为.zh: 那个我认为会通过考试的朋友失败了。
认为.pinyin: Nà ge wǒ rèn wéi huì tōng guò kǎo shì de péng you shī bài le
认为.en: The friend who I thought would pass the exam failed it.
认为.es: El amigo que pensé que aprobaría el examen lo suspendió.

一般.pinyin: Yī bān wǒ bù xíng qù xué xiào
Nǐ men yī bān jǐ diǎn xià bān
一般.en: When do you usually get off work?
一般.es: ¿A qué hora sueles salir de trabajar?

一般.pinyin: Nǐ yī bān jǐ diǎn xià bān
一般.en: When do you usually get off work?
一般.es: ¿A qué hora sueles salir de trabajar?

一般.zh: 这蛋糕吃起来不同一般。
一般.pinyin: Zhè dàn gāo chī qǐ lai bù tóng yī bān

后来.zh: 我本来想走的，但后来忘了。
后来.pinyin: Wǒ běn lái xiǎng zǒu de dàn hòu lái wàng le
后来.en: I wanted to go, but I forgot.

后来.zh: 后来我知道了，蛇是没有用来听声音的耳朵的。
后来.pinyin: Hòu lái wǒ zhī dào le shé shì méi yǒu yòng lái tīng shēng yīn de ěr duo de
后来.en: Then I was made aware that snakes have no ears with which to hear.
后来.es: Entonces me enteré de que las serpientes no tienen oídos con los que puedan oír.

后来.zh: 这个传闻后来被证明是真的了。
后来.pinyin: Zhè ge chuán wén hòu lái bèi zhèng míng shì zhēn de le
后来.en: The rumor turned out to be true.

后来.zh: 我本来对摇滚乐没甚么好感，但后来却渐渐喜欢上了。
后来.pinyin: Wǒ běn lái duì yáo gǔn yuè méi shèn má hǎo gǎn dàn hòu lái què jiàn jiàn xǐ huan shàng le
后来.en: I didn't like rock music at first, but it soon grew on me.
后来.es: No me gustó la música rock en un principio, pero de a poco me empezó a gustar.

交通.zh: 这个城市的交通方便得很。
交通.pinyin: Zhè ge chéng shì de jiāo tōng fāng biàn de hěn
交通.en: The transportation in this city is very convenient.
交通.es: El transporte en esta ciudad es muy conveniente.

交通.zh: 这间酒店的交通位置很方便。
交通.pinyin: Zhè jiān jiǔ diàn de jiāo tōng wèi zhi hěn fāng biàn
交通.en: This hotel is conveniently located in terms of public transportation.
交通.es: Este hotel está muy bien situado en lo que concierne al transporte público.

交通.pinyin: Tā yīn jiāo tōng shì gù sǐ wáng
交通.en: He was killed in a car accident.
交通.es: Lo mataron en un accidente de tráfico.

交通.pinyin: Nà chǎng yì wài shǐ jiāo tōng dà luàn
交通.es: El accidente fue la causa del caos circulatorio.

艺术.zh: 我父亲一点也不懂艺术。
艺术.pinyin: Wǒ fù qīn yī diǎn yě bù dǒng yì shù
艺术.en: My father is far from artistic.
艺术.es: Mi padre dista mucho de ser artístico.

艺术.pinyin: Nǐ qù kàn yì shù zhǎn lǎn le ma
艺术.en: Did you go to the art exhibition?

艺术.pinyin: Wǒ mǔ qīn jiāo chā huā yì shù
Tā zài yì shù shì jiā zhǎng dà
艺术.en: He was raised in an artistic family.
艺术.es: Él fue criado en una familia artística.

优秀.zh: 我觉得他是一个优秀的作家。
优秀.pinyin: Wǒ jué de tā shì yī ge yōu xiù de zuò jiā
优秀.en: I consider him a great writer.

优秀.pinyin: Tā shì yī ge yōu xiù de zuò jiā

优秀.zh: 她的父亲是一位优秀的钢琴家。
优秀.pinyin: Tā de fù qīn shì yī wèi yōu xiù de gāng qín jiā
优秀.en: Her father is an excellent pianist.
优秀.es: Su padre es un excelente pianista.

优秀.zh: 他是一个优秀的脑外科医生。
优秀.pinyin: Tā shì yī ge yōu xiù de nǎo wài kē yī shēng

否则.zh: 除非是你做饭，否则我是不会吃的。
否则.pinyin: Chú fēi shì nǐ zuò fàn fǒu zé wǒ shì bù huì chī de
否则.en: I won't eat it unless you cooked it.
否则.es: No lo voy a comer a menos que lo hayas preparado tú.

否则.zh: 除非你想去, 否则你不必去这个派对。
否则.pinyin: Chú fēi nǐ xiǎng qù fǒu zé nǐ bù bì qù zhè ge pài duì
否则.en: You don't have to go to the party unless you want to.
否则.es: No tienes que ir a la fiesta si no quieres.

否则.zh: 快点, 否则你会赶不上火车。
否则.pinyin: Kuài diǎn fǒu zé nǐ huì gǎn bù shàng huǒ chē
否则.en: Hurry up, or you will miss the train.

否则.zh: 快点，否则你会错过公车。
否则.pinyin: Kuài diǎn fǒu zé nǐ huì cuò guò gōng chē
否则.en: Hurry up, or you'll miss the bus.
否则.es: Date prisa o perderás el autobús.

从来.zh: 这是我从来吃过最好吃的蛋糕。
从来.pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ cóng lái chī guo zuì hǎo chī de dàn gāo
从来.en: This is the best cake that I have ever eaten.
从来.es: Éste es el mejor pastel que he comido hasta ahora.

从来.pinyin: Wǒ zhōu rì cóng lái dōu bù zài jiā
从来.en: I am never at home on Sundays.
从来.es: Los domingos nunca estoy en casa.

从来.zh: 遇到你之前，我从来都没感觉到这样。
从来.pinyin: Yù dào nǐ zhī qián wǒ cóng lái dōu méi gǎn jué dào zhè yàng
从来.en: I never felt this way before I met you.
从来.es: Yo nunca me sentí de esta manera antes de conocerte.

从来.zh: 从来就没有徒劳的爱情。
从来.pinyin: Cóng lái jiù méi yǒu tú láo de ài qíng
从来.es: Amar a alguien no es nunca un desperdicio.

存.zh: 他把赚到的钱都存了起来。
存.pinyin: Tā bǎ zhuàn dào de qián dōu cún le qǐ lai
Wǒ dǎ suàn cún gèng duō qián
存.en: I'm going to save more money.

存.zh: 许多网路公司为求生存而需要新颖的商业模式。
存.pinyin: Xǔ duō wǎng lù gōng sī wèi qiú shēng cún ér xū yào xīn yǐng de shāng yè mó shì
存.en: Many on-line companies need to have a new approach to business to survive.
存.es: Muchas compañías en internet necesitan tener un nuevo enfoque para que las empresas sobrevivan.

存.pinyin: Wǒ guān jī qián wàng le cún pán
存.en: I forgot to save the file before switching off.

零钱.zh: 对不起, 我没有零钱。
零钱.pinyin: Duì bu qǐ wǒ méi yǒu líng qián
零钱.en: I'm sorry, I don't have change.

零钱.pinyin: Wǒ méi rèn hé líng qián
Bù yòng zhǎo líng qián le

比如.zh: 在日本有很多美丽的城市。比如京都呀奈良等。
比如.pinyin: Zài rì běn yǒu hěn duō měi lì de chéng shì bǐ rú jīng dū ya nài liáng děng
比如.en: Japan is full of beautiful cities. Kyoto and Nara, for example.
比如.es: Japón está lleno de ciudades hermosas. Por ejemplo, Kyoto y Nara.

比如.zh: 我不是很中国人，比如我不觉得台湾是中国领土。
比如.pinyin: Wǒ bù shì hěn zhōng guó rén bǐ rú wǒ bù jué de tái wān shì zhōng guó lǐng tǔ
比如.en: I'm not very Chinese. For example, I don't believe that Taiwan is Chinese territory.

比如.zh: 爬树的动物, 比如猫, 长有爪子。
比如.pinyin: Pá shù de dòng wù bǐ rú māo cháng yǒu zhuǎ zi
比如.en: Animals that climb trees, like cats, have claws.

比如.zh: 勇气是非常重要的。比如肌肉，经常使用才得以加强。
比如.pinyin: Yǒng qì shì fēi cháng zhòng yào de bǐ rú jī ròu jīng cháng shǐ yòng cái dé yǐ jiā qiáng
比如.en: Courage is very important. Like a muscle, it is strengthened by use.

似乎.zh: 这个科幻故事似乎很有趣。你看完的时候能不能借给我？
似乎.pinyin: Zhè ge kē huàn gù shi sì hū hěn yǒu qù nǐ kàn wán de shí hou néng bù néng jiè gěi wǒ
似乎.en: This science fiction story seems interesting. Will you lend it to me when you have finished reading it?
似乎.es: Esta historia de ciencia ficción parece ser interesante. ¿Me la prestas cuando la hayas terminado de leer?

似乎.pinyin: Nà fáng zi sì hū méi yǒu rén zhù
似乎.en: The house gave no sign of life.
似乎.es: La casa no daba signos de vida.

似乎.zh: 她似乎比以往任何时候都漂亮。
似乎.pinyin: Tā sì hū bǐ yǐ wǎng rèn hé shí hou dōu piào liang
似乎.en: She looked more beautiful than ever.
似乎.es: Ella parecía más bonita que nunca.

幸运.pinyin: Nǐ zhēn de hěn xìng yùn bù shì ma
幸运.en: You really are lucky, aren't you?

幸运.pinyin: Tā shì duō me xìng yùn de rén a
幸运.en: What a lucky person he is!

幸运.zh: 这年对他来说是幸运的一年。
幸运.pinyin: Zhè nián duì tā lái shuō shì xìng yùn de yī nián
幸运.en: This year has been a lucky one for him.
幸运.es: Este año ha sido un año con suerte para él.

幸运.zh: 你们很幸运有这样的朋友们。
幸运.pinyin: Nǐ men hěn xìng yùn yǒu zhè yàng de péng you men
幸运.en: You are very fortunate that you have such friends.
幸运.es: Eres muy afortunado de tener tales amigos.

缺乏.zh: 我们因缺乏准备而失败了。
缺乏.pinyin: Wǒ men yīn quē fá zhǔn bèi ér shī bài le
缺乏.en: We failed due to a lack of preparation.
缺乏.es: Nosotros fracasamos por la falta de preparación.

缺乏.zh: 他有我所缺乏的东西: 信心。
缺乏.pinyin: Tā yǒu wǒ suǒ quē fá de dōng xi xìn xīn
缺乏.en: He has what I lack; confidence.

缺乏.zh: 他思考的方式缺乏深度，这个我们知道就好。
缺乏.pinyin: Tā sī kǎo de fāng shì quē fá shēn dù zhè ge wǒ men zhī dào jiù hǎo
缺乏.en: Between you and me, he has a shallow way of thinking.

缺乏.zh: 考虑到他缺乏经验，他做得[已经]非常好了。
缺乏.pinyin: Kǎo lǜ dào tā quē fá jīng yàn tā zuò de yǐ jīng fēi cháng hǎo le
缺乏.en: He is doing very well considering he lacks experience.

摘.pinyin: Tā gěi wǒ zhāi le yī ge píng guǒ
Tā wèi tā zhāi le xiē huā

摘.zh: 进教室的时候请把帽子摘了。
摘.pinyin: Jìn jiào shì de shí hou qǐng bǎ mào zi zhāi le
摘.en: Take off your hat when you enter a classroom.
摘.es: Quítate el sombrero cuando entres a un aula.

摘.pinyin: Tā zài huā yuán lǐ zhāi huā
摘.en: She picked flowers in the garden.
摘.es: Ella recogía flores en el jardín.

迎接.zh: 她用一个微笑迎接了我。
迎接.pinyin: Tā yòng yī ge wēi xiào yíng jiē le wǒ
迎接.en: She greeted me with a smile.
迎接.es: Ella me recibió con una sonrisa.

迎接.zh: 无论老幼，人们都出来迎接贵客。
迎接.pinyin: Wú lùn lǎo yòu rén men dōu chū lái yíng jiē guì kè
迎接.en: People, old and young, all came out to greet the guests.
迎接.es: Toda la gente, mayor y joven, salió a dar la bienvenida a los visitantes.

迎接.zh: 我要去机场迎接我的家人。
迎接.pinyin: Wǒ yào qù jī chǎng yíng jiē wǒ de jiā rén
迎接.en: I have to go to the airport to meet my family.

迎接.zh: 我准备好迎接死亡了。我希望别太难受。
迎接.pinyin: Wǒ zhǔn bèi hǎo yíng jiē sǐ wáng le wǒ xī wàng bié tài nán shòu
迎接.en: I am ready to die. I hope it's not too uncomfortable.

飘.zh: 我见到一片白云在空中飘过。
飘.pinyin: Wǒ jiàn dào yī piān bái yún zài kōng zhōng piāo guo
飘.en: I saw a white cloud sailing across the sky.
飘.es: Vi una nube blanca flotar a través del cielo.

飘.zh: 我感觉像羽毛一样轻飘。
飘.pinyin: Wǒ gǎn jué xiàng yǔ máo yī yàng qīng piāo
飘.en: I felt light as a feather.
飘.es: Me sentía ligero como una pluma.

飘.pinyin: Yī duǒ bái yún zài lán tiān shàng piāo
飘.en: A white cloud is floating in the blue sky.
飘.es: Una nube blanca flota en el cielo azul.

飘.pinyin: Tiān kōng zhōng piāo guo yī duǒ yún
飘.en: A cloud floated across the sky.
飘.es: Una nube flotó por el cielo.

实话.pinyin: Shí huà shuō wǒ bù zàn chéng nǐ
实话.en: To tell the truth, I don't agree with you.
实话.es: Francamente hablando, yo no estoy de acuerdo contigo.

实话.pinyin: Tā shuō de méi yǒu yī jù shí huà
实话.en: There isn't a grain of truth in what he says.
实话.es: No hay ni una pizca de verdad en lo que él dice.

实话.pinyin: Tāng mǔ méi yǒu gào su wǒ shí huà
实话.en: Tom didn't tell me the truth.
实话.es: Tom no me dijo la verdad.

疲劳.pinyin: Wǒ de yǎn jing pí láo
Wǒ de yǎn jing hěn róng yì pí láo
疲劳.en: My eyes get tired very easily.
疲劳.es: Mis ojos se cansan con facilidad.

疲劳.zh: 他疲劳过度，又睡眠不足，最后便病倒了。
疲劳.pinyin: Tā pí láo guò dù yòu shuì mián bù zú zuì hòu biàn bìng dǎo le
疲劳.en: What with fatigue and lack of sleep, he has fallen ill at last.

疲劳.zh: 他因为太疲劳而无法继续前进。
疲劳.pinyin: Tā yīn wèi tài pí láo ér wú fǎ jì xù qián jìn
疲劳.en: He was too tired to go any further.

胆小鬼.pinyin: Tā shì gè dǎn xiǎo guǐ
胆小鬼.en: He is afraid of his own shadow.
胆小鬼.es: Tiene miedo de su propia sombra.

胆小鬼.zh: “坦白说，我有恐高症。”“你是个胆小鬼！”
胆小鬼.pinyin: Tǎn bái shuō wǒ yǒu kǒng gāo zhèng nǐ shì gè dǎn xiǎo guǐ
胆小鬼.en: "To tell you the truth, I am scared of heights." "You are a coward!"
胆小鬼.es: "A decir verdad, tengo vértigo." "¡Eres un cobarde!"

胆小鬼.pinyin: Nǐ jiù shì dǎn xiǎo guǐ
Tā men chēng tā dǎn xiǎo guǐ

神话.zh: 神话让我们能透悉古文明。
神话.pinyin: Shén huà ràng wǒ men néng tòu xī gǔ wén míng
神话.en: The myth offers insights into the ancient civilization.
神话.es: Leyendo esa leyenda se puede comprender con profundidad la civilización antigua.

神话.zh: 在希腊神话中，阿瑞斯是战争之神。
神话.pinyin: Zài xī là shén huà zhōng ā ruì sī shì zhàn zhēng zhī shén
神话.en: In Greek mythology, Ares was the god of war.
神话.es: En la mitología griega, Ares era el dios de la guerra.

神话.zh: 保罗的成功是一个神话。
神话.pinyin: Bǎo luó de chéng gōng shì yī ge shén huà

神话.zh: 神话和传说应该一代一代的传承下去。
神话.pinyin: Shén huà hé chuán shuō yīng gāi yī dài yī dài de chuán chéng xià qù
神话.en: Myths and legends should be handed down from generation to generation.

官.zh: 那嫌疑犯对侦察官撒了个谎。
官.pinyin: Nà xián yí fàn duì zhēn chá guān sā le gè huǎng
官.en: The suspect told a lie to the inspector.

优惠.pinyin: Wǒ men yǒu gè yōu huì yào gěi nǐ
优惠.en: We've got an offer for you.

优惠.zh: 我可能会线上查看优惠与折扣。
优惠.pinyin: Wǒ kě néng huì xiàn shàng chá kàn yōu huì yǔ zhé kòu
优惠.en: I might check for sales or discounts online.

优惠.zh: 如用现金付款，我们给予九折优惠。
优惠.pinyin: Rú yòng xiàn jīn fù kuǎn wǒ men jǐ yǔ jiǔ zhé yōu huì
优惠.en: We give a 10% discount for cash.

优惠.zh: 购买新装置的用户可享有额外试用优惠。
优惠.pinyin: Gòu mǎi xīn zhuāng zhì de yòng hù kě xiǎng yǒu é wài shì yòng yōu huì
优惠.en: Customers who purchase a new device can enjoy additional trial period as a promotional offer.

难免.zh: 我们知道人皆难免一死。
难免.pinyin: Wǒ men zhī dào rén jiē nán miǎn yī sǐ
难免.en: We know that all men are mortal.
难免.es: Sabemos que todos los hombres son mortales.

难免.pinyin: Shì qing nán miǎn huì fā shēng

难免.zh: ...不然难免会有适得其反的情况出现。
难免.pinyin: Bù rán nán miǎn huì yǒu shì dé qí fǎn de qíng kuàng chū xiàn
难免.en: ... Otherwise it is (or will be) hard to avoid a counterproductive situation.

各自.zh: 请回到你们各自的座位。
各自.pinyin: Qǐng huí dào nǐ men gè zì de zuò wèi

各自.zh: 汤姆和玛丽从他们各自的书桌前站起身来。
各自.pinyin: Tāng mǔ hé mǎ lì cóng tā men gè zì de shū zhuō qián zhàn qǐ shēn lái
各自.en: Tom and Mary got up from their desks.

果实.zh: 他在收获他的劳动果实。
果实.pinyin: Tā zài shōu huò tā de láo dòng guǒ shí
果实.en: He is reaping the fruits of his labor.

果实.pinyin: Xiàng shù de guǒ shí shì shén me
果实.en: What is the fruit of the oak?

果实.zh: 西班牙人用草莓树的果实酿造一种白兰地。
果实.pinyin: Xī bān yá rén yòng cǎo méi shù de guǒ shí niàng zào yī zhǒng bái lán dì
果实.en: The Spanish make a type of brandy with the fruits of the strawberry tree.

乘.zh: 你乘飞机还是乘火车去？
乘.pinyin: Nǐ chéng fēi jī hái shi chéng huǒ chē qù
乘.en: Are you going by air or by train?

乘.zh: 要去博物馆，你就得乘那辆车。
乘.pinyin: Yào qù bó wù guǎn nǐ jiù de chéng nà liàng chē
乘.en: You have to get on that bus to go to the museum.
乘.es: Tienes que coger ese autobús para ir al museo.

乘.zh: 她不会乘飞机因为害怕坠机。
乘.pinyin: Tā bù huì chéng fēi jī yīn wèi hài pà zhuì jī
乘.en: She won't take an airplane for fear of a crash.
乘.es: Se niega a coger el avión por miedo a un accidente.

乘.pinyin: Chéng gōng jiāo chē fèi shí

艘.zh: 我想要一艘船带我远离这里。
艘.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng yào yī sōu chuán dài wǒ yuǎn lí zhè lǐ
艘.en: I want a boat that will take me far away from here.
艘.es: Quiero un barco que me lleve lejos de aquí.

艘.zh: 他们警告过这艘船这个危险。
艘.pinyin: Tā men jǐng gào guo zhè sōu chuán zhè ge wēi xiǎn
艘.en: They warned the ship about the danger.
艘.es: Ellos le advirtieron al barco acerca del peligro.

艘.pinyin: Zhè sōu chuán méi yǒu léi dá zhuāng bèi
艘.en: The ship is not equipped with radar.
艘.es: Este barco no está equipado con radar.

艘.zh: 那艘船失去平衡，翻了过来。
艘.pinyin: Nà sōu chuán shī qù píng héng fān le guò lái
艘.en: Due to a lack of balance the ship turned over.

无辜.pinyin: Wǒ xiāng xìn tā shì wú gū de
无辜.en: I am convinced that he is innocent.
无辜.es: Estoy convencido de que es inocente.

无辜.pinyin: Tā dāng rán shì wú gū de
Tā xiāng xìn tā shì wú gū de
无辜.en: She believes that he is innocent.
无辜.es: Ella piensa que él es inocente.

无辜.pinyin: Tā jiǎ shè tā shì wú gū de
无辜.en: She presumes him to be innocent.
无辜.es: Ella presume que él es inocente.

逮捕.zh: 警察逮捕了谋杀这位小姐的凶手。
逮捕.pinyin: Jǐng chá dài bǔ le móu shā zhè wèi xiǎo jie de xiōng shǒu
逮捕.en: The police arrested the man who had murdered the girl.
逮捕.es: La Policía arrestó al hombre que asesinó a la niña.

逮捕.pinyin: Tā bèi jǐng fāng dài bǔ le
逮捕.en: She was arrested by the police.
逮捕.es: Ella fue arrestada por la policía.

逮捕.pinyin: Jǐng fāng dài bǔ le xián yí rén

逮捕.zh: 警察因酒后驾驶逮捕了他。
逮捕.pinyin: Jǐng chá yīn jiǔ hòu jià shǐ dài bǔ le tā
逮捕.en: The policeman arrested him for drunken driving.
逮捕.es: El policía lo arrestó por conducir bebido.

折.pinyin: Néng gěi wǒ dá gè zhé má
折.en: Can you give me a discount?

折.pinyin: Wǒ zhé le jià zhǐ fēi jī

折.zh: 教我怎么折纸鹤吧。我忘记怎么折了。
折.pinyin: Jiāo wǒ zěn me zhé zhǐ hè ba wǒ wàng jì zěn me zhé le
折.en: Teach me how to fold a paper crane. I forgot how to fold it.
折.es: Enséñame a hacer una grulla de papel. Me he olvidado de cómo se hace.

折.zh: 她整齐地把她的手帕折好。
折.pinyin: Tā zhěng qí de bǎ tā de shǒu pà zhé hǎo

定期.pinyin: Tā yǐ qián dìng qī lái kàn wǒ
定期.en: She used to visit me regularly.

定期.zh: 她定期去看牙医，所以她很少牙痛。
定期.pinyin: Tā dìng qī qù kàn yá yī suǒ yǐ tā hěn shǎo yá tòng
定期.en: She visits the dentist on a regular basis, so she seldom gets toothaches.
定期.es: Ella visita al dentista de manera regular, así que rara vez tiene dolor de muelas.

定期.zh: 她定期去看牙医，因此很少牙疼。
定期.pinyin: Tā dìng qī qù kàn yá yī yīn cǐ hěn shǎo yá téng
定期.en: She goes to the dentist regularly, so she seldom gets toothache.
定期.es: Ella visita al dentista de manera regular, así que rara vez tiene dolor de muelas.

定期.pinyin: Huó huǒ shān huì dìng qī bào fā
定期.en: The active volcano erupts at regular intervals.
定期.es: El volcán activo entra en erupción a intervalos regulares.

示意.pinyin: Fù qīn shì yì wǒ lí kāi fáng jiān
示意.en: Father gestured to me to leave the room.
示意.es: Mi padre me hizo un gesto que abandonara el cuarto.

示意.zh: 我父亲示意我离开会议室。
示意.pinyin: Wǒ fù qīn shì yì wǒ lí kāi huì yì shì
示意.en: My father motioned for me to leave the meeting room.

示意.zh: 裁判根据有利原则，举起手示意继续进攻。
示意.pinyin: Cái pàn gēn jù yǒu lì yuán zé jǔ qǐ shǒu shì yì jì xù jìn gōng
示意.en: The referee, according to principle of advantage, raised his hand and motioned for the advance to continue.

示意.zh: 助理裁判向主裁判举旗示意比赛继续。
示意.pinyin: Zhù lǐ cái pàn xiàng zhǔ cái pàn jǔ qí shì yì bǐ sài jì xù
示意.en: The assistant referee held up his flag to show the referee that the ball was still in play.

液体.pinyin: Nǐ yīng gāi hē dà liàng de yè tǐ
液体.en: You should drink a lot of liquid.

液体.zh: 水是液体。冻起来就成了固体。
液体.pinyin: Shuǐ shì yè tǐ dòng qǐ lai jiù chéng le gù tǐ
液体.en: Water is liquid. When it freezes, it becomes solid.
液体.es: El agua es un líquido. Cuando se congela, se vuelve sólido.

液体.pinyin: Shuǐ hé yóu dōu shì yè tǐ
液体.en: Water and oil are both liquids.
液体.es: El agua y el aceite son líquidos.

实施.zh: 广泛的安全措施实施了。
实施.pinyin: Guǎng fàn de ān quán cuò shī shí shī le
实施.en: Broad safety measures were put into effect.

实施.zh: 根本就没实施过逮捕行动。
实施.pinyin: Gēn běn jiù méi shí shī guo dài bǔ xíng dòng

授予.pinyin: Tā céng jīng bèi shòu yǔ jīn pái
授予.en: He's been awarded a gold medal once.
授予.es: Él recibió en una ocasión una medalla de oro.

授予.zh: 特蕾莎修女被授予诺贝尔奖。
授予.pinyin: Tè lěi shā xiū nǚ bèi shòu yǔ nuò bèi ěr jiǎng
授予.en: Mother Teresa was given the Nobel prize.
授予.es: Madre Teresa recibió el premio Nobel.

授予.zh: 他们在画展上授予了她一等奖。
授予.pinyin: Tā men zài huà zhǎn shàng shòu yǔ le tā yī děng jiǎng
授予.en: They awarded her first prize at the art exhibition.

授予.zh: 这名士兵被授予紫心勋章。
授予.pinyin: Zhè míng shì bīng bèi shòu yǔ zǐ xīn xūn zhāng
授予.en: This soldier was awarded the Purple Heart.

排练.zh: 他们不是在打架，而是在排练戏剧。
排练.pinyin: Tā men bù shì zài dǎ jià ér shì zài pái liàn xì jù
排练.en: They aren't quarreling, but are rehearsing a play.
排练.es: Ellas no están peleando, sino que están ensayando una obra.

排练.zh: 明天是运动会的排练，没有往常的课程。
排练.pinyin: Míng tiān shì yùn dòng huì de pái liàn méi yǒu wǎng cháng de kè chéng
排练.en: Tomorrow there will be no normal lessons, in view of the athletic meet rehearsal.

排练.zh: 最近一直在舞蹈排练，周五周六要演出啊。
排练.pinyin: Zuì jìn yī zhí zài wǔ dǎo pái liàn zhōu wǔ zhōu liù yào yǎn chū a
排练.en: Lately there have been constant dance rehearsals; Performances will be on Friday and Saturday.

探望.zh: 她探望了她在监狱里的丈夫。
探望.pinyin: Tā tàn wàng le tā zài jiān yù lǐ de zhàng fu
探望.en: She visited her husband in prison.
探望.es: Ella visitó a su marido en la cárcel.

探望.zh: 我已经很久没有探望过祖母了。
探望.pinyin: Wǒ yǐ jīng hěn jiǔ méi yǒu tàn wàng guo zǔ mǔ le
探望.en: It's been a long time since I visited my grandmother.
探望.es: Ha pasado mucho tiempo desde que visité a mi abuela.

探望.zh: 海伦每个星期天探望她的叔叔。
探望.pinyin: Hǎi lún měi ge xīng qī tiān tàn wàng tā de shū shu
探望.en: Helen visits her uncle every Sunday.
探望.es: Helen visita a su tío cada domingo.

探望.zh: 我的叔叔们有时会来探望我。
探望.pinyin: Wǒ de shū shu men yǒu shí huì lái tàn wàng wǒ
探望.en: My uncles come to see me from time to time.

暴露.zh: 不要把皮肤长时间暴露在阳光里。
暴露.pinyin: Bù yào bǎ pí fū cháng shí jiān bào lù zài yáng guāng lǐ
暴露.en: Skin shouldn't be exposed to sunlight for too long.

暴露.pinyin: Mǎ lì zhuó zhuāng bào lù

惊奇.pinyin: Tā jīng qí de kàn zhe wǒ
惊奇.en: He looked at me in surprise.

惊奇.zh: 感到惊讶、感到惊奇就是明白的开始。
惊奇.pinyin: Gǎn dào jīng yà gǎn dào jīng qí jiù shì míng bai de kāi shǐ
惊奇.en: To be surprised, to wonder, is to begin to understand.
惊奇.es: Sorprenderse, extrañarse, es comenzar a entender.

惊奇.pinyin: Rì běn chōng mǎn jīng qí

翘.zh: 教授骂了约翰一顿因为他翘了几堂课。
翘.pinyin: Jiào shòu mà le yuē hàn yī dùn yīn wèi tā qiào le jǐ táng kè
翘.en: The professor scolded John for skipping class.

翘.zh: 他翘著二郎腿坐在那里。
翘.pinyin: Tā qiào zhe èr láng tuǐ zuò zài nà li
翘.en: He sat there with his legs crossed.

翘.zh: 玛丽翘着二郎腿坐在沙发上。
翘.pinyin: Mǎ lì qiào zhe èr láng tuǐ zuò zài shā fā shàng
翘.en: Mary sat cross-legged on the couch.

上级.zh: 现在父亲在他的办公室已经得到了一个上级的地位。
上级.pinyin: Xiàn zài fù qīn zài tā de bàn gōng shì yǐ jīng dé dào le yī ge shàng jí de dì wèi
上级.en: Father has now got a superior position in his office.
上级.es: Ahora, papá consiguió un puesto superior en su oficina.

出路.pinyin: Nà shi wéi yī de chū lù
出路.en: It was the only way to go.

器官.zh: 舌头和上颚都是味觉器官。
器官.pinyin: Shé tou hé shàng è dōu shì wèi jué qì guān
器官.en: The tongue and the palate are the taste organs.

奔波.zh: 在一整天工作的奔波中，她的腿变得酸痛。
奔波.pinyin: Zài yī zhěng tiān gōng zuò de bēn bō zhōng tā de tuǐ biàn de suān tòng
奔波.en: Her feet were tired after a long day at work.

渺小.zh: 眼前的景色让齐里感到自身的渺小。
渺小.pinyin: Yǎn qián de jǐng sè ràng qí lǐ gǎn dào zì shēn de miǎo xiǎo
渺小.en: Ziri felt humbled by such a scenery.

忘.pinyin: Yǒu yī tiān nǐ huì wàng le wǒ
Wǒ wàng le nǐ de diàn huà hào mǎ
Wǒ wàng le dǎ diàn huà gěi tā
忘.es: Me olvidé de llamarle por teléfono.

车站.zh: 你在车站遇到的男人是我爸爸。
车站.pinyin: Nǐ zài chē zhàn yù dào de nán rén shì wǒ bà ba
车站.en: The man you met at the station is my father.
车站.es: El hombre que conociste en la estación es mi padre.

车站.pinyin: Wǒ jiā lí chē zhàn hěn jìn
车站.en: My house is near the station.
车站.es: Mi casa está cerca de la estación.

车站.zh: 能否告诉我去车站的路怎么走？
车站.pinyin: Néng fǒu gào su wǒ qù chē zhàn de lù zěn me zǒu
车站.en: Could you tell me the way to the station?
车站.es: ¿Me puedes decir cómo llegar a la estación?

车站.en: He will have to go to the station.
车站.es: Él tendrá que ir a la estación.

变.pinyin: Wǒ duì tā de tài du biàn le

变.zh: 这些天我的视力正在变差。
变.pinyin: Zhè xiē tiān wǒ de shì lì zhèng zài biàn chà
变.en: My vision is getting worse these days.
变.es: Mi vista ha ido empeorando estos días.

变.pinyin: Shū cài de jià gé měi tiān zài biàn
变.en: The price of vegetables varies from day to day.
变.es: El precio de los vegetales cambia diariamente.

变.pinyin: Yīng guó de tiān qì jīng cháng biàn
变.en: The weather changes very often in England.
变.es: El clima cambia seguido en Inglaterra.

棒球.pinyin: Tā shì gè bàng qiú shǒu
Nǐ bù xǐ huan bàng qiú ma

棒球.zh: 如果明天天气好，我们就去打棒球。
棒球.pinyin: Rú guǒ míng tiān tiān qì hǎo wǒ men jiù qù dá bàng qiú
棒球.en: If it is fine tomorrow, we will play baseball.
棒球.es: Si mañana hace buen tiempo, iremos a jugar al béisbol.

棒球.zh: 他既不喜欢棒球，又不喜欢足球。
棒球.pinyin: Tā jì bù xǐ huan bàng qiú yòu bù xǐ huan zú qiú
棒球.en: He likes neither baseball nor football.
棒球.es: A él no le gusta el béisbol ni el fútbol.

星期天.zh: 昨天是星期天，所以我睡了一整天的觉。

敲打.pinyin: Tāng mǔ hé mǎ lì de xiǎo ér zi xǐ huan zuò zài chú fáng dì bǎn shàng qiāo dǎ guō wǎn piáo pén
敲打.en: Tom and Mary's little boy loves sitting on the kitchen floor banging pots and pans.
敲打.es: El pequeño niño de Tom y Mary adora sentarse en el suelo de la cocina y golpetear ollas y cacerolas.

敲打.pinyin: Yǔ dī qiāo dǎ chuāng hu bō li
敲打.en: The rain beats against the window pane.

新兴.pinyin: Zhōng guó shì yī ge xīn xīng shì chǎng

无期徒刑.zh: 汤姆有可能会被判无期徒刑。
无期徒刑.pinyin: Tāng mǔ yǒu kě néng huì bèi pàn wú qī tú xíng
无期徒刑.en: Tom could face life in prison.

无期徒刑.pinyin: Tāng mǔ zhèng zài fú wú qī tú xíng
无期徒刑.en: Tom is serving a life sentence.

明知.zh: 明知山有虎，别去明知山。
明知.pinyin: Míng zhī shān yǒu hǔ bié qù míng zhī shān
明知.en: Knowing That the Mountain has tigers, so don't go to Knowing That the Mountain.

某处.pinyin: Tā jiā zài zhèr mǒu chù
某处.en: His house is somewhere about here.
某处.es: Su casa está aquí en algún lugar.

核子.zh: 我们所有的人都想除掉核子武器。
核子.pinyin: Wǒ men suǒ yǒu de rén dōu xiǎng chú diào hé zǐ wǔ qì
核子.en: All of us would like to get rid of nuclear weapons.

游乐.zh: 汤姆总是在玩电视游乐器。
游乐.pinyin: Tāng mǔ zǒng shì zài wán diàn shì yóu lè qì
游乐.en: Tom is always playing video games.
游乐.es: Tom siempre está ocupado con juegos de vídeo.

游乐.pinyin: Wǒ zài wán diàn shì yóu lè qì

湘.zh: 告诉我你在湘南做了什么。
湘.pinyin: Gào su wǒ nǐ zài xiāng nán zuò le shén me
湘.en: Tell me what you did in Shounan.

湘.zh: 告诉我你对湘南做了什么。
湘.pinyin: Gào su wǒ nǐ duì xiāng nán zuò le shén me
湘.en: Tell me what you did to Shounan.
湘.es: Dime qué le has hecho a Shounan.

煎锅.zh: 我把蔬菜在煎锅里糖渍。
煎锅.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ shū cài zài jiān guō lǐ táng zì
煎锅.en: I candy the vegetables in the frying pan.
煎锅.es: Confito las verduras en la sartén.

煎锅.zh: 我每天至少用一次煎锅。
煎锅.pinyin: Wǒ měi tiān zhì shǎo yòng yī cì jiān guō
煎锅.en: I use a frying pan at least once a day.

痘.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎo shí hou fā shuǐ dòu
痘.en: I had chicken pox when I was a kid.

痘.pinyin: Zhè hái zi yǒu shuǐ dòu de zhèng zhuàng
痘.en: The child has a case of chicken pox.

直角.pinyin: Zhí jiǎo shì jiǔ shí dù
直角.en: A right angle has ninety degrees.

直角.pinyin: Zhè liǎng tiáo xiàn chéng zhí jiǎo xiāng jiāo
直角.en: These two lines cut across each other at right angles.

米尔顿.pinyin: Tā cháng yǐn yòng mǐ ěr dùn
米尔顿.es: Él a menudo cita a Milton.

米尔顿.zh: 你曾经读过米尔顿的作品吗 ?
米尔顿.pinyin: Nǐ céng jīng dú guo mǐ ěr dùn de zuò pǐn ma
米尔顿.en: Have you ever read Milton's works?

美日.zh: 他被任命为驻美日本大使。
美日.pinyin: Tā bèi rèn mìng wèi zhù měi rì běn dà shǐ
美日.en: He was accredited to the United States to represent Japan.

腰围.zh: 你认为汤姆的腰围是多少？
腰围.pinyin: Nǐ rèn wéi tāng mǔ de yāo wéi shì duō shao
腰围.en: What do you think Tom's waist size is?

蒙古国.zh: 蒙古国夹在俄罗斯和中国之间。
蒙古国.pinyin: Měng gǔ guó jiā zài é luó sī hé zhōng guó zhī jiān
蒙古国.en: Mongolia is sandwiched between Russia and China.

观测.zh: 为了观测星象，他建了一座天文台。
观测.pinyin: Wèi le guān cè xīng xiàng tā jiàn le yī zuò tiān wén tái
观测.en: He built an observatory to study the stars.

车费.zh: 从大阪到秋田的车费是多少？
车费.pinyin: Cóng dà bǎn dào qiū tián de chē fèi shì duō shao
车费.en: What is the fare from Osaka to Akita?

迈阿密.zh: 卡罗下个月将参观迈阿密。
迈阿密.pinyin: Kǎ luó xià gè yuè jiāng cān guān mài ā mì
迈阿密.en: Carol will visit Miami next month.
迈阿密.es: Carol visitará Miami el mes que viene.

迈阿密.pinyin: Zǒng tǒng mù qián zài mài ā mì
迈阿密.en: The president is presently in Miami.

铺路.pinyin: Qián rén pū lù hòu rén xíng lù
铺路.en: One generation builds the street that the next will travel on.

Gǔ zhé de tuǐ hái méi hǎo

不干不净.pinyin: Bù gān bù jìng chī le méi bìng
不干不净.en: It may not be clean, but you won't get sick from eating it.

不沾锅.zh: 炒蔬菜时，重要的是使用不沾锅。
不沾锅.pinyin: Chǎo shū cài shí zhòng yào de shì shǐ yòng bù zhān guō
不沾锅.en: When sautéing vegetables, it is important to use a non-stick pan.

丰年.en: A timely snow promises a good harvest.
丰年.es: Año de nieves, año de bienes.

乔治亚.zh: 请问乔治亚洲的最低工资是多少？
乔治亚.pinyin: Qǐng wèn qiáo zhì yà zhōu de zuì dī gōng zī shì duō shao
乔治亚.en: What is the minimum wage in Georgia?
